hand_example.label: Synthetic 1,000-task hand calculation (illustrative, not measured)

checks.rejected_excluded_from_latency: rejected latency not measured; latency stats computed over admitted tasks only (no zero-latency rejected bucket)
checks.forwarded_is_path_event: forwarded 100 <= admitted 850; ingress RSU != execution RSU for those 100; no double-counting
checks.inequalities: offered(1000) >= admitted(850) >= started(850) >= compute_completed(700) >= returned(680) >= deadline_success(600); compute_completed == returned+dropped (700==680+20)

denominators.headline_rule: Report 0.6 (offered) as headline; 0.7059 is conditional diagnostic only

hand_example.waiting_room_ceiling_note: Example RSU ceiling 2.5 per-vehicle * N=2488 padded slots = 6220 absolute tasks per RSU; ceiling is admission limit, not compute service rate.
hand_example.placement_admission_scaling_note: gate_rejected is admission gate; capacity_rejected is waiting-room full; forwarded is placement; compute_completed/returned separation is execution/return; no scaling change in this hand check.
